body.p:
Click the Browse button to the right of the Working copy combo box to select a working copy from your file system. The selected folder must be a Git repository.
When a working copy is opened, the Git Client automatically detects outdated local branches in the background. These are branches linked to remote branches that no longer exist. In this situation, a warning dialog box displays the outdated local branches and gives you the option to delete them.
The detection process for outdated local branches also occurs periodically after loading a working copy (every 3.5 hours). This ensures that your project is checked twice during an 8-hour working day.
If the current branch is detected as outdated, you must switch to another branch before you can delete it.
